title.description: The title of the admin's page that lists the pages of the site with a layout of their own, each on a card, and the way back to it from the page of one.

description.defaultMessage: The pages of the site with a layout of their own. Open one to change what it says.
description.description: The line under the title of the page that lists the site's own pages: what it holds, and what to do there.

content.description: The first tab of the admin's page for one of the site's own pages: the editor of its metadata and of what is written on it.

list.description: The accessible name of the list of cards, one for each of the site's own pages.

home.description: The name of the site's home page: the heading of its card, and the title of its page in the admin.

homeDescription.defaultMessage: The hero the site opens with, its picture, and the welcome written under it.
homeDescription.description: The line on the home page's card, and under the title of its page in the admin: what of the home page is changed there.

about.description: The name of the site's About Us page: the heading of its card, and the title of its page in the admin.

aboutDescription.defaultMessage: The title and description the page opens with, and the church’s vision and beliefs written under them.
aboutDescription.description: The line on the About Us page's card, and under the title of its page in the admin: what of About Us is changed there.

connect.description: The name of the site's connect page: the heading of its card, and the title of its page in the admin.

connectDescription.defaultMessage: How to find and reach the church: its address, phone, fax and email, and its office hours.
connectDescription.description: The line on the connect page's card, and under the title of its page in the admin: what of the connect page is changed there.

notFound.description: The error shown when the editor of one of the site's own pages finds no row for it.
